name: Grapevine Step

instructions.description: Stand tall and step one foot to the side.
Cross the other foot in front or behind, then step to the side again in a repeating pattern.
Keep the steps light and rhythmical while your trunk stays upright.
Reverse the pattern to move in the opposite direction.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a pace that allows coordinated foot placement.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Remove the crossing pattern to simplify coordination.

commentsNotes: Start slowly until the pattern feels automatic.
Use enough space to avoid obstacles.
